heading.purpose: Section titles, preceded by the small trail sign.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on every interactive element.

motion.name: sign-morph
motion.purpose: Signpost entry turning into a sign.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action. Yellow plate, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font: 600 15px 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1d1b10; background: #ffcc00; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #f2bd00; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #1c1e1d, 0 0 0 5px #ffcc00; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Native input with strong hairline and yellow focus halo.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; font: 400 15px 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1c1e1d; background: #fcfcfb; border: 1px solid #868d89; border-radius: 4px; outline: none; } .ds-input:hover, .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #1c1e1d; } .ds-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #ffcc00; }

components.name: Signpost entry
components.description: Current section in the nav, drawn as a pointed trail sign.
components.css: .ds-sign { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 24px 0 12px; font: 600 15px 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1d1b10; background: #ffcc00; text-decoration: none; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 14px) 0, 100% 50%, calc(100% - 14px) 100%, 0 100%); }

narrative.overview: A component kit read at a glance, like a Swiss hiking-trail sign: one yellow-and-ink action pairing on cool stone, standard controls, tight radii, flat surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Signal yellow with granite ink as the only accent
Cool stone neutrals, granite night in dark
Pointed sign as the signature shape

rules.name: One Accent
rules.body: Yellow is the only accent; red and green only carry danger and success.

rules.name: Ink on Yellow
rules.body: Text on yellow is always sign ink; yellow fills get an ink edge on light surfaces.

rules.name: Flat by Default
rules.body: Only the modal casts a shadow.
